title: Review visual and input behaviour independently
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Verify the release visually and across inputs.

**Expected behaviour** · Review desktop, 390 px and 320 × 600 with Solid/Glass, long labels, flip frames, cursor lock, shelf edges, reduced motion and touch.

**Scope boundary** · Record input hardware and any untested pen behaviour.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-040

**Depends on** · WI-024, WI-035, WI-038, WI-039

**Verify** · Capture expected and observed results with viewport, input sequence, visual evidence and a reproducible defect list.

**Effort basis** · Visual judgement and device-dependent verification.
evidence: GLM 5.3 Flash visual review in versions/0.2 FoundationOS/agents/qa/WI-041/report.md. One Sev-1: component boundaries at 1.1-2.3:1, including an undefined --fo-glass-border giving a white edge on near-white Glass. Fixed with solid #5f7088 boundary tokens; independent retest revised the verdict to PASS with 0 Sev-1 and measured 3.17-5.05:1 in every physically achievable light/dark, Solid/Glass combination (dark-glass page side 3.17 is the watch item). Text 4.91-17.28, focus rings 4.92-10.34. Turn frames, cursor geometry, motion tokens, narrow layouts and note corrections verified. Owner accepted PI-02 on 27 November 2026.
